meta.name: storytelling-influence
meta.description: Coach users on storytelling, communication, and influence using 45 practitioner-tested techniques from Lenny Rachitsky's archive. Use when drafting presentations, preparing for stakeholder conversations, writing executive communications, pitching ideas, seeking buy-in, or improving persuasion. Triggers on "how should I present this", "help me pitch", "get buy-in", "convince", "influence", "stakeholder prep", "improve my writing", "presentation feedback", "storytelling", "executive presence", "meeting prep", or any request to make a communication more compelling.
